explanation: This unit is mostly a clock that rises with trial number: about 0 for trials 1-30, about 1-2 around trials 40-60, 3-4 around trials 70-85, 7-8 around trials 90-93, and it saturates at 9-10 by trials 94-99, with D1 at that level, GO much lower (about one third of D1, so 0-2 early and 2-6 late, higher after a1 following reward), and D2 in between (about 0-1 early, 4-5 around trial 90, 6-8 late). Late in the episode D2 gets a further bump to 8-10 after a rare transition or when the previous trial went unrewarded.
